license: GPL-3.0 (strong copyleft: incorporating any of its code into a proprietary service obliges source disclosure of the combined work; ideas and patterns are not covered, so clean-room reimplementation only)
status_note: active, single author, pnpm monorepo (frontend on Cloudflare Pages, Hono server in Docker, Supabase Postgres); credit-pack billing, Cloudflare Pages deploy and custom domains are wired; depends on @earendil-works/pi-agent-core and pi-ai pinned to 'latest'
core_problem: Pay-per-generation static site builder for semi-technical users: a tool-calling agent plans a typed site spec, writes each HTML page through a validating write tool, edits with exact-once search/replace, self-validates, and the result is deployed to Cloudflare Pages.
architecture: server/src/lib/generation/agent.ts exports generateWebsite(), an async generator that builds an Agent from @earendil-works/pi-agent-core with model getModel('openai','gpt-5.6-terra'), thinkingLevel 'low', a system prompt from system-prompt.ts, and tools from tools.ts, then relays AgentEvents (tool_execution_start/end, message_end usage) as GenerationEvents over SSE from routes/generate.ts after reserving credits. tools.ts (TypeBox schemas): plan_site fills a typed SiteSpec (type enum landing|portfolio|business|saas|restaurant|agency|blog|ecommerce, tone enum, siteComplexity enum minimal|fun|standard|premium, colorPalette of five hex strings, typography enums, pages[] with sections[] {type, headline, subheadline, content, layout, elements}, features[]); write_page runs validateHtml() and refuses to store the page when hard issues exist, returning the issue list to the agent; read_page; edit_page applies search/replace where each 'old' must occur exactly once (0 or >1 occurrences fail with a corrective message), re-validates, but saves even with issues; validate_site is a model self-report (overallQuality enum, per-page issues/suggestions). agent-interface.ts validateHtml: hard issues = missing DOCTYPE/html/head/body, missing tailwindcss or alpinejs CDN, any image src or css url() outside the allowlist (illustrations.popsy.co, data:); quality warnings = duplicate consecutive section types (class-name sniffing), hero without link/button, adjacent section py-N ratio > 3, same-tone text/background Tailwind class pairs, Popsy URL validity, accessibility heuristics, missing AOS/Lucide. system-prompt.ts = senior-designer persona + workflow (plan_site → write_page per page with <!-- SECTION: name --> markers → validate_site → edit_page fixes) + a DESIGN ANTI-PATTERNS list ('Welcome to [Business]', generic testimonials, dark gradient + floating orbs for every site, same section order every time) + text-forward image policy (no Unsplash/Pexels/picsum/placehold; Popsy SVGs, inline SVG, CSS shapes, gradient orbs) + microinteraction and inline Heroicon snippets + prompts.ts DESIGN_SYSTEM_PROMPT (industry-specific intuition, FONT_PAIRINGS) + design-seeds.ts generateDesignSeed(seed, complexity) (mulberry32 PRNG picks one layout strategy, two signature motifs, hero constraint, CTA style, section-order twist, typography twist, spacing personality, visual texture; fun/minimal variants with emoji directives) + components.ts selectComponentExamples(sectionTypes, seed) (about 1400 lines of HTML exemplars over 19 section types, one per needed type plus two extras, seeded shuffle). interpreter.ts is a separate generateObject/Zod SiteSpecSchema planner on gpt-5.4-mini (appears to be a pre-agent path). skills.ts holds post-hoc whole-HTML rewrite prompts (seo, accessibility, performance, darkMode). lib/analytics/html-quality.ts computes hasSingleH1, ordered headings, CTA above fold, and palette consistency (declared hex palette vs hex values used). Frontend renders pages and shows an AgentActivityLog from tool events.
core_innovation: The write tool is the gate: page output is validated by deterministic code inside the tool call and rejected back to the agent with structured issues, while a seeded design-directive bundle and seeded exemplar selection make each generation's creative constraints reproducible from an integer seed.
strengths: ValidatingWriteTool: write_page refuses invalid HTML and returns the issue list, so the agent's self-repair loop is driven by code checks rather than by its own judgement; toolMetrics counts pagesFailedValidation and fixAttemptsPerPage.

Typed plan before generation: plan_site's TypeBox schema forces the model to commit to enums (site type, tone, complexity, heading style, body font), a five-colour palette and a page/section outline before any HTML is written; the spec is emitted as an event and stored.

Seeded design directive: generateDesignSeed derives layout strategy, motifs, hero constraint, CTA style, section-order twist, typography twist, spacing and texture from a mulberry32 PRNG, so variety is reproducible and loggable rather than left to temperature.
Seeded exemplar selection: selectComponentExamples picks reference HTML per needed section type from the same seed, with an explicit instruction not to copy verbatim.
Image-source allowlist enforced in code over both and css url(); the 'no stock photos' rule is a hard validation failure, not advice.
Exact-once search/replace edits with corrective error messages for zero or multiple matches; read_page-before-edit discipline in the prompt.
html-quality.ts palette-consistency metric compares the declared palette to hex values actually used; a cheap 'did the output honour the plan' check.
Honest text-forward fallback: when no real photos exist, the design leans on typography, colour blocks and inline SVG instead of stock imagery (matches the idea of a no_photo_fallback).
Complexity-aware scope (minimal/fun modes cap sections and forbid forced testimonials/pricing) prevents corporate-ifying a party invite.
weaknesses: GPL-3.0: no code can be reused in our product; patterns only.

Output contract is still raw HTML strings per page; sections are HTML comments, not typed nodes, so validation is substring and regex sniffing over class names with no DOM parse, no axe-core, no Lighthouse.
Generated pages load Tailwind Play CDN, Alpine.js, AOS and Lucide from CDNs at runtime; four render-blocking or layout-shifting scripts in production output, no budgets.
validate_site is an LLM self-assessment with an 'excellent|good|needs_improvement' enum, the rejected design-critic pattern; it does not gate anything and the agent decides when it is done.

The seed vocabulary contains the very clichés the prompt bans: 'bold gradient background with floating geometric shapes', 'dark section with glowing accent elements', 'gradient orbs', 'glassmorphism with frosted elements', 'pill-shaped buttons', 'gradient text highlights'; and write_page's own description says 'follow modern design patterns with gradients, glassmorphism'.

plan_site makes the model infer positioning, palette, tone and industry; our rule is that positioning is owner-declared and design system ids are selected from eligible sets, never invented as hex values.
Prompt explicitly asks for fabricated social proof ('Testimonials with specific details (names, companies, concrete results)'), a trust and legal hazard for a real client.
Popsy/undraw illustrations are a recognisable startup-template tell; the allowlist swaps one cliché for another.
edit_page saves pages that fail validation; only write_page is a true gate.
Model id 'gpt-5.6-terra' and all server deps pinned to 'latest'; pi-agent-core comes from a tiny org with unknown maintenance; interpreter.ts and plan_site duplicate the planning role.
One star, single author, no tests in the generation package visible.
patterns_to_steal: ValidatingWriteTool → anti_slop tier-1 and assembly: the model's selection call is accepted only if the deterministic gate passes; on failure return structured issues and re-prompt with a bounded attempt counter (fixAttemptsPerPage) that feeds telemetry.

SeededDirectiveBundle → creative_direction and decision_manifest: derive the set of eligible arrangement choices offered to the model from a recorded integer seed so a generation is reproducible and the seed appears in the manifest; the vocabulary must be our authored arrangements, not prose adjectives.
ImageSourceAllowlist (extractImageUrls over src and css url()) → qa_gate placeholder/asset scan: fail on any host outside owned object storage; extend to <script src> and <link href>.
PaletteConsistencyCheck (declared palette vs used colours) → anti_slop tier-1: assert that only the selected design system's tokens appear in rendered CSS, zero foreign hex values.
ToolCallMetrics (writePageCalls, pagesFailedValidation, fixAttemptsPerPage, usage) → telemetry: per-generation counters that become evidence for priors promotion (which arrangements fail gates most).
ExactOnceEdit → visual_editor / agent patch semantics post-V1: an edit must address exactly one node (by id), and ambiguity is an error returned to the caller.

ComplexityTier (minimal|fun|standard|premium capping sections) → page_archetype selection: archetype choice should bound section count and forbid inapplicable beats, computed in code from owner inputs.
TextForwardFallback → art_direction no_photo_fallback: typographic and colour-block arrangements when no eligible real photos exist, but with illustration packs banned.
patterns_to_avoid: LLM validate_site self-report with a quality enum → the rejected design-critic gate; keep tier-2 LLM judge warning-only and never let the model decide it is done.
Model-invented palette, tone and positioning in plan_site → violates owner-declared positioning and 'model selects ids, never emits tokens'.
Fabricated testimonials with names and companies → every claim must be in FactRegistry with provenance and a quotable flag.
Seed vocabulary that includes gradient orbs, glassmorphism, glowing accents → the directive bundle must draw only from the human-authored section library.
Raw HTML per page with comment section markers → not Zod-typed, not diffable; keep SiteDefinition JSON.
Four CDN runtimes (Tailwind Play, Alpine, AOS, Lucide) in shipped pages → breaks the 180 kB JS budget and Lighthouse budgets; Astro islands with near-zero JS instead.
Popsy/undraw illustration allowlist → a different template tell; art direction forbids generic illustration packs as well as ai_generated_person.
Any GPL code reuse → clean-room only.
reusable_patterns: ValidatingWriteTool: the tool that persists output runs deterministic checks and rejects with structured issues; invalid output never enters state.
SeededDirectiveBundle: creative constraints sampled from a recorded seed via a fixed PRNG so variety is reproducible and auditable.
ImageSourceAllowlist: extract every image and css url() reference and fail on any host not on the allowlist.
ExactOnceEdit: search/replace or node edits must match exactly one location; zero or many is an error returned to the caller.
PaletteConsistencyCheck: compare colours declared in the plan or design system to colours present in the output.
ToolCallMetrics: count tool invocations, validation failures and fix attempts per artifact as telemetry.
adoption_strategy: Adapt (patterns only, clean-room; GPL forbids code reuse). Reimplement the validating-write-tool loop as our tier-1 gate boundary: the model's SiteDefinition selection is accepted only after Zod plus deterministic checks pass, failures return structured issues with a bounded retry counter that is logged. Take the seeded directive idea but bind the seed to our authored arrangement library and record it in the Decision Manifest. Port the image/host allowlist and palette-consistency checks into launch QA and tier-1. Reject the LLM validate_site self-score, the model-inferred palette and positioning, the fabricated testimonials instruction, the CDN runtime stack and the illustration-pack allowlist.
